purpose: Prospective external Prompt TSG qualification population; not an intervention-effect dataset.

population_rule.selection: Complete census after the pre-extraction overlap exclusions; no outcome-informed or hash-based sampling.

overlap_audit.comparison_population: The previously curated seven-source task corpus.
overlap_audit.semantic_review_rule: Exclude only a pair that requires the same principal operation on the same object under materially the same functional contract; a shared CWE or mechanism is not enough.

provenance_limits: This source is an independently maintained benchmark repository, not a peer-reviewed accuracy gold standard.
The external qualification supports transfer to this frozen Python population only; it is not a global semantic-parsing accuracy claim.
